mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_chat_attachment (id, original_name, file_ext, content_type, file_size, storage_path, uploader_id, del_flag, create_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{originalName}, #{fileExt}, #{contentType}, #{fileSize}, #{storagePath}, #{uploaderId}, '0', NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id AS id, original_name AS originalName, file_ext AS fileExt, content_type AS contentType, file_size AS fileSize, storage_path AS storagePath, uploader_id AS uploaderId, del_flag AS delFlag, create_time AS createTime FROM t_chat_attachment WHERE id = #{id} AND del_flag = '0'
